---
title: "AminoAcidShift"
---

The mitochondrial light-strand spectrum is strongly asymmetric: G to A and T to C are in excess. That spectrum predicts a long-term flow from loser amino acids (Leu, Phe, Cys, Trp, Gly, Val) toward gainer amino acids (Pro, His, Gln, Asn, Lys, Thr).

These pages show the tables and figures currently in the repository. They do not refit the models. When an analysis changes, rerun `uv run python site/build_interactive.py` and render this site again.
